remote_code_review.reviewed_behavior: Configuration, torch model layers, inference, cache and generation routines; no filesystem, network, shell, subprocess or dynamic exec/eval operations found.
remote_code_review.adapter_path: Official embedding/prelude, core_block_forward repeated R times, then ln_f/full coda/ln_f/lm_head for each h1 and hR.
remote_code_review.mask_limitation: Native forward ignores attention_mask; adapter rejects left padding/holes and only gathers true prefix positions. Causal attention prevents right suffix padding from influencing scored positions.
remote_code_review.initialization: Native std=config.init_values[std], truncation +/-3 std, then multiply model.emb_scale. Adapter draws inverse-CDF trunc_normal on CPU float32 in fixed 64-token blocks, keyed by SHA256(seed1234,questionID), and supplies identical input_states for native validation.
remote_code_review.rng_difference: Native performs an unused randn draw before trunc_normal; adapter omits that shape-sensitive RNG consumption. Paper seed and sample ordering are not specified.
